content: Oku Nyamuzinda abêraga Abayahudi burhè
Co cirhumire nâwe, ciru wankabà we ndi, orhankayêra ciru n’ehitya, we okâtwa olwa bene, bulyâla omu kutwa olwa bene, kuciyâza ociyâza; kulya kubà, wâni nyamutwa-olwa-bene, oku ajira kwo nâwe ojira.
Rhurhanahabiri oku abajira bene okwo Nyamuzinda ye batwîra olubanja lw’okuli.
Nâwe, we kâtwa emmanja z’abajira ntyo, n’obwo nâwe kw’oli akâbo, k’omanyire mpu wâfuma olubanja lwa Nyamuzinda?
Nkabaga kugayaguza ogayaguzize obuhirhi bw’obwinjà n’olukogo n’obutûdu bwâge? K’orhîshi oku obwo bwonjo bwa Nyamuzinda bukulalisire mpu ocîyunjuze?
Obûla ohûsize omurhima gwâwe orhanalonza okucîyunjuza, k’orhîshi oku odwîrhe wacihakira enguli y’obukunizi oku lusiku lwa ngerera-hano, lwo lusiku olubanja lw’okuli lwa Nyamuzinda lwânabonekane,
alyûle ngasi muntu nk’oku ebijiro byâge binakwânîne:
abantu bacîshwêkera oku kujira aminjà, abalonza irenge n’obukuze n’okurhafà, abashobôze obuzîne bw’ensiku n’amango;
nabo abagoma, balya barhakenga okuli, balya banywâna n’obubî, bâbone obukali n’obukunizi.
Obuhanya n’amalibuko garheganyizîbwe ngasi muntu ojira amabî: burhanzi Abayahudi, kandi Abagereki;
ci irenge n’obukuze n’omurhûla birheganyizîbwe ngasi muntu ojira aminjà: burhanzi Abayahudi, kandi Abagereki;
bulya Nyamuzinda arhajira kabôlo.
Oluhembo lw’abarhayishi Amarhegeko ci bajira aminjà
Ngasi bantu boshi bajizire kubî buzira irhegeko
, bafè buzira irhegeko; na ngasi bajizire kubî banamanyire irhegeko, banatwîrwe olubanja nk’oku irhegeko linadesire.
Bulya arhali abayumvîrhiza amarhegeko kwône bo bêru-kwêru embere za Nnâmahanga, ci abajira oku amarhegeko gadesire bo bayêre.
Ngasi mango abapagani bakulikira obwôrhere bwâbo bwinjà ciru ankaba barhagwêrhi marhegeko, bakajira ebijiro binjà, omurhima gwâbo gunabêre ahâli h’amarhegeko.
Banayêrekane oku amarhegeko gali mayandike omu murhima gwâbo; entimanya zâbo zinahamîrize ntyo, n’omurhima gwâbo hali amango gubabwîra oku bajizire kubî.
Kwo byabwikûke ntyo, nk’oku nyigîriza omu Myanzi yâni y’Akalembe, amango Nyamuzinda arhuma Kristu mpu atwe olubanja lw’ebifulisirwe omu mirhima y’abantu.
Ci kwône, we negenera okuderhwa Muyahudi, we yegemera amarhegeko, we cîkuza muli Nnâmahanga,
we yishi obulonza bwâge, we yish’ihanûla ebiri binjà mpu we wayigîrizîbwe amarhegeko,
we cikubagira mpu oli cirongôzi c’emihûrha, mpu oli kamole k’abâli omu mwizimya,
we mwigîriza w’abahwinja, mwalimu w’ebirhaba mpu obwenge irhegeko likuzabûlire ebinwa by’obumanye n’eby’okuli!
Ewani sho! oyigîriza abandi, ci orhacîyigîriza wêne! Ohanûla okurhazimba, ogal’izimba wêne!
Ohanza okuhusha, onagal’inahusha! Onaderhe mpu oshomba enshushano z’abazimu, ogal’inakazimba omu ngombe zâbo!
We negenera irhegeko, ogal’inakalivuna, kugayisa ogayîsa Nyamuzinda.
Nka kulya biyandisirwe: mwe murhuma izîno lya Nnâmahanga lijâcirwa omu mashanja.
Okukembûlwa
Okukembûlwa, nêci, kwanakulêrhera amakwânane, akabà oshimba amarhegeko; ci akabà orhashimba marhegeko, we wakembwîrwe, okola oli nk’orhakembûlagwa.
Omuntu orhali mukembûle, erhi akashimba amarhegeko, k’arhumânîni n’owakembwîrwe n’obwo arhakembûlagwa?
N’oyo muntu oshimba amarhegeko, ciru akabà arhali mukembûle, ayish’itwa o­lwâwe, we vuna amarhegeko n’obwo wakembwîrwe.
Bulya Omuyahudi arhali omu masù abonekera, n’obukembûle arhali omu mubiri bubà

Omuyahudi menemene omu murhima obuyahudi bwâge bubà; n’obukembûle bw’okuli omu murhima bubà, bubà bwa murhima; ci burhabà bwa myandiko. Obukembûle bwa bene obwo burhenza obukuze, arhali emwa abantu, ci emwa Nnâmahanga.
